emergency.condition_text: a removal spell or ability is pointed at Shabraz or Brallin, and that commander's tax is about to go up by two
indications: A seat passes with {W}, {B} or {1}{U} open the turn after a commander lands.
A commander is on the battlefield with nothing on it: no Lightning Greaves, Brotherhood Regalia or Robe of Stars.
The table has already answered one commander. In game 001 Brallin was removed twice and the tax came on (log:001).
The commander has counters on it. The table reads counters as the kill and aims removal at them.
immediate: Read the removal. Note three things: does it target, is it a spell or an ability, and does it destroy, deal damage, exile or bounce.

If it targets, answer the target first. Cast Deflecting Swat for free (you control a commander) and point it at one of their permanents, or cast Loran's Escape for {W}: hexproof makes the spell lose its target. Or channel Otawara, Soaring City for {2}{U} with one legend out, returning your own commander to your hand.

If it is a noncreature spell and step 2 did not answer it, counter it. Stubborn Denial for {U} is a hard counter once a creature of yours has 4 power. Negate costs {1}{U}. Izzet Charm costs {U}{R} and they can pay {2}.

If it is still coming: against destroy or damage, cast Flawless Maneuver for free. Against exile or bounce, phase the commander out: Robe of Stars ({1}{W}, if it is equipped), March of Swirling Mist ({1}{U} for X=1), or Talon Gates of Madara ({4} from hand, its enter trigger aimed at your commander).
If nothing answers it, put the commander in the command zone and say the new tax aloud: Brallin 4, then 6, then 8; Shabraz 5, then 7, then 9.
subsequent: A commander bounced to your hand stays in your hand. You recast it from hand, which adds no tax.
Before recasting from the command zone, tap and sacrifice Command Beacon if you have it. It puts the commander in your hand, and that cast pays no tax.
Recast with Lightning Greaves already on the battlefield. Equip it for {0} the turn he lands: haste and shroud, so the cast turn is an attack turn.
If one commander has been removed twice, play the other one. The Equipment stays on the battlefield; Brotherhood Regalia moves to a legend for {1}.
Keep Flawless Maneuver and Deflecting Swat in hand from here on. Both are free only while you control a commander, so they do nothing on a turn both are in the command zone.
emergency.notes: Lightning Greaves gives shroud, and shroud stops YOUR targeting too. With Greaves on a commander you cannot attach Embercleave or Brotherhood Regalia, cannot give him Shu Yun's or Boros Charm's double strike, cannot put Inti's counter on him, and the commanders cannot hand each other flying or trample. Equip everything else first and move Greaves off last. Game 001 was played on v1.2.0, before the voltron and answers merges (log:001).

emergency.condition_text: another seat is assembling a loop or a one-turn kill, and your answers are a handful of instants
indications: A seat tutors twice in one turn, or plays a piece and holds its mana up.
A seat whose deck checks at bracket 4 sits at a table with your bracket 3 list. Game 002 ended on Ryan's infinite with his Teval deck (log:002).
A sacrifice outlet and a recursion piece sit on one board.
A seat's life total or token count jumps on a turn it attacks nobody.
immediate: Name the piece already on the battlefield that the loop needs. That piece is the target.

Answer it at instant speed: Swords to Plowshares ({W}) exiles a creature, Get Lost ({1}{W}) destroys a creature or enchantment, Chaos Warp ({2}{R}) shuffles away any permanent, Prismari Command ({1}{U}{R}) destroys an artifact, Teferi, Master of Time's -3 phases a creature out on their turn.
If the last piece is a noncreature spell from hand, hold {U} for Stubborn Denial or {1}{U} for Negate on that seat's turn and counter it.
If nothing answers it, count your own kill for this turn: 21 commander damage at one seat, or Brallin's pings at every seat. If it is there, take it now.
subsequent: From the turn a seat shows its first piece, keep {W} and {1}{U} open ahead of tapping out for Equipment or a conversion enchantment.
Collective Defiance and Incendiary Command are sorceries. Cast them in your own main phase on the piece already down; they cannot be held up for the turn the loop goes off.

If the combo seat's pieces are in its hand, aim Collective Defiance's first mode at that seat ({1}{R}{R}): it discards its hand and draws as many. The discards are theirs, so neither commander triggers.
Cast Grand Abolisher before your kill turn. On your turn no opponent casts a spell or activates an artifact, creature or enchantment ability, so a combo piece cannot respond to your swing.
emergency.notes: Your answers stop permanents, not a graveyard. Against a loop that returns pieces from the graveyard, hit the outlet or the engine on the battlefield and leave the yard. Game 002 was played on v1.3.0 at a table the pilot called bracket 4 against his bracket 3 list (log:002).

emergency.condition_text: the mana has stopped short of a commander, or the colour it needs is not there
indications: Three lands on turn four. The goldfish hits its land drop on turn 4 in 79.4% of games and on turn 5 in 70.8%.
No rock by turn three. In game 001 the only fast mana was Sol Ring in the opener and nothing followed it (log:001).
Four mana and no red: Brallin, Torbran ({1}{R}{R}{R}) and Gratuitous Violence ({2}{R}{R}{R}) sit in hand.
Game 003 on v2.0.0 was 'mana starved one round' and 'slow to get cards out' (log:003).
immediate: If you hold no land, loot before the land drop: Faithless Looting ({R}), Kitsa's tap, Izzet Charm's third mode ({U}{R}). Discard spells, keep lands.
Play the land. Take the untapped one if it casts something this turn; Spectator Seating and Training Center enter untapped with two or more opponents.
Cast the cheapest rock before any other spell: Sol Ring, then Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Izzet Signet or Talisman of Creativity.
With three lands, cast Frantic Search ({2}{U}): it draws two, discards two and untaps three lands, so it costs nothing net.
With four mana and a red source, cast Brallin. He is one cheaper than Shabraz, and every loot after him grows him and pings the table.
subsequent: With Stoneforge Mystic out, put Embercleave onto the battlefield with her ability for {1}{W} instead of casting it for six.
Cast Prismari Command at the end of the turn before yours, choosing Treasure and the loot on yourself.
Put Smothering Tithe down before a symmetrical wheel. Wheel of Fortune and Reforge the Soul make each opponent draw seven: every card they do not pay {2} for is a Treasure.
Discard Islands and Pirates to Mary Read and Anne Bonny's loot. Each one makes a tapped Treasure.
Sorcerer Class level 2 mana pays for instants, sorceries and Class levels only. It does not cast a commander or pay an equip.
emergency.notes: Red is the colour that runs short: deck-audit counts 34 red sources against a target of 36, and the commanders' road through Brallin, Torbran and Gratuitous Violence is red. When the hand has two colours of mana and red is not one of them, Shabraz ({3}{W}{U}) is the commander to cast. Game 003 was on v2.0.0; answers-v1 and the powertune-v1 land pass came after it, and no game has been logged on v2.1.1 (log:003).

emergency.condition_text: it is turn five or later, no commander has stuck, and the hand is wheels and payoffs
indications: Turn five with no commander on the battlefield. The goldfish casts Brallin by turn six in 95.8% of games and Shabraz in 87.7%, with no removal in it, so this is already behind that ceiling.
A hand of two or more wheels and one creature. That was the keep in game 002 (log:002).
Both commanders have been answered and the taxes are 6 and 7.
Game 003 read 'slow to get cards out' with no removal drawn (log:003).
immediate: Cast a commander before any wheel, Brallin first. A wheel with no commander out pays no counter, no ping and no life.
Equip Lightning Greaves to it the turn it lands, after any other Equipment, and attack with the haste.

Loot every turn after that: Kitsa, Mary Read and Anne Bonny, Faithless Looting, Teferi, Master of Time's +1 on another seat's turn. Each loot pays Brallin a counter and a ping, or Shabraz a counter and a life.
Hold the wheels until the commander has survived a full turn cycle (log:002).
subsequent: If the table is ahead, refill only your own hand: Tolarian Winds and Fateful Showdown discard and redraw your hand alone. A symmetrical wheel refills the seats that are winning.
Cast Fateful Showdown on the blocker or the engine in your way. It deals damage equal to your hand size, then wheels your hand.
With both commanders taxed, recast one. Put the other's mana into a conversion piece for the one on the battlefield.

If Idyllic Tutor is in hand, fetch the enchantment the commander on the battlefield needs: Torbran is a creature, so for Brallin take Gratuitous Violence or Artist's Talent; for Shabraz take Teferi's Ageless Insight.
emergency.notes: The exception: cast Tolarian Winds with no commander out when your hand cannot be cast. It digs for lands and a commander's protection, it is an instant, and it refills no opponent. Cast it at the end of the turn before yours.

emergency.condition_text: the table has turned on the wheels and you have become the problem
indications: A seat complains when you cast a wheel. The pilot saw the table split on them in game 001: 'people either loved it or hated it' (log:001).
You have wheeled twice before any commander is big. In game 002 the pilot named repeated discards as the thing the table did not enjoy (log:002).
Removal starts coming at you before your board is the largest one.
Two seats stop attacking each other.
immediate: Stop casting symmetrical wheels for card flow. Loot instead: Kitsa, Mary Read and Anne Bonny, Faithless Looting, Teferi, Master of Time's +1.
Save the next wheel for the turn it ends a game or puts a commander within one swing of 21 (log:002).
When you need a refill, cast the one-sided ones: Tolarian Winds, Fateful Showdown, or Collective Defiance's first mode aimed at yourself.
Spend your next removal spell on the seat that is ahead, and say so at the table.
subsequent: Name Brallin's pings before you loot. They hit every opponent; do not promise a seat a pass you break with your next discard.
Cast Consecrated Sphinx on the turn before the wheel, not earlier. Beside Brallin it is the board of stack 009, and the table will aim the next removal at it.
Offer an answer for another seat's problem in exchange for a turn without removal aimed at you. Swords to Plowshares and Get Lost are the cards to offer.
emergency.notes: A wheel that refills an opponent's empty hand is a gift to that seat. When one seat is at zero or one card, cast Tolarian Winds or Fateful Showdown, not Wheel of Fortune or Windfall.

emergency.condition_text: a sweeper is coming or has landed, and a commander and its Equipment are on the board
indications: A white or black seat passes with four or more mana open and a board behind yours.
Both commanders are on the battlefield with counters, and you have cast your creatures into an open sweeper mana.
A seat with a sweeper in its colours has drawn a fresh hand from your wheel.
A seat that was losing on board stops casting creatures.
immediate: Read the sweeper. Note whether it destroys, deals damage, exiles, bounces or gives -X/-X.
If it is a spell, counter it: Stubborn Denial ({U}, hard with a 4-power creature), Negate ({1}{U}) or Izzet Charm ({U}{R}).
Against destroy or damage, cast Flawless Maneuver for free (you control a commander). Boros Charm's second mode ({R}{W}) and Akroma's Will's second mode ({3}{W}) give indestructible too.

Against exile, bounce or -X/-X, phase the commander out: March of Swirling Mist with X equal to the creatures you save, exiling blue cards from hand to cut {2} each, or Robe of Stars ({1}{W}) on the equipped creature.
Let it resolve. A commander bounced to hand stays in hand; one that dies or is exiled goes to the command zone, and you say the new tax aloud.
subsequent: Recast one commander, not both. Keep the second in the command zone as the next rebuild.
The Equipment survives a creature sweeper. Re-equip on the commander you recast: Brotherhood Regalia {1}, Lightning Greaves {0}, last.
Hold the wheels until the commander you recast has survived a turn cycle.
Before your next creature, count the sweeper seat's open mana again.
emergency.notes: Phasing out takes the Equipment with it and brings both back attached, and the counters stay on. Grand Abolisher stops spells only on your turn, so it never stops a sweeper cast on theirs. No logged game has ended on a wipe.

emergency.condition_text: a seat's board will kill you before your commander reaches 21, and you cannot block it
indications: A go-wide board with more attackers than you have blockers. Stuart's zombie tokens in game 001 were a board the pilot could not prune (log:001).
A seat's attack takes a third or more of your life in one swing.
Your commander is two or more swings from 21 at the seat that is ahead.
You are tapping out on your turn and have no creature untapped on theirs.
immediate: Count both clocks aloud: how many of their swings kill you, and how many of yours kill them.

If theirs is shorter, answer the largest attacker at instant speed on their turn: Swords to Plowshares ({W}), Get Lost ({1}{W}), Izzet Charm's 2 damage, Teferi, Master of Time's -3, or Fateful Showdown for damage equal to your hand size.
Against a board of small creatures, cast Incendiary Command ({3}{R}{R}) choosing 2 to each creature and a second mode. Before you cast it, count your own creatures with 2 or less toughness.
Leave Shabraz and Bard, King of Dale untapped as blockers. Bard has reach and vigilance and blocks a flyer after attacking.
Loot on their turn with Teferi, Master of Time's +1. With Shabraz out, each draw is 1 life.
subsequent: Go over the board, not through it. Shabraz flies, Shabraz's {W/U} gives Brallin flying, and Brotherhood Regalia makes the carrier unblockable.
Point commander damage at the racing seat until it is gone.
Cast Akroma's Will with both modes on your swing: lifelink and double strike on every creature you control.
emergency.notes: Brallin's pings hit players, never creatures. A wheel does not remove a single token, so against a wide board the wheel is the finisher only after the board is answered. Game 001 has no logged result; it is cited for the board that could not be cut back, not as a loss to a race (log:001).

keep: Two to five lands. With two lands, a rock as well: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Izzet Signet or Talisman of Creativity.
At least one creature or one rock.
At most one wheel. Two wheels and one creature is the hand the pilot doubted in game 002 (log:002).
A red source, so Brallin is castable on turn four.
Cheap card flow is a reason to keep: Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Kitsa, Faithless Looting, Stoneforge Mystic.
ship: Zero or one land, or six or more.
Two or more wheels with no creature and no rock.
A hand with no red source and no rock that makes red.
A hand that needs a commander out before it does anything: Blade Historian, Embercleave, Gratuitous Violence, Fiery Emancipation and wheels with no early plays.
preflight.note: The goldfish keeps its first seven in 79.6% of games; it mulligans on land count alone. In a multiplayer game the first mulligan does not cost a card. Gemstone Caverns in the opener goes onto the battlefield before turn one if you are not the starting player: exile a wheel or a payoff, never a rock or a land.

steps: Turn one: land, then Sol Ring if you have it; otherwise Mystic Remora, Marauding Mako or Faithless Looting.
Turn two: a rock, Kitsa, Stoneforge Mystic, Inti, Sorcerer Class, Faerie Mastermind or Ledger Shredder. Stoneforge fetches Lightning Greaves if the hand has no protection, Embercleave if it does.
Turn three: Rhystic Study, Lae'zel, Shu Yun, Mary Read and Anne Bonny, Glint-Horn Buccaneer or a second rock. Cast Jace's Archivist only to hold it; do not activate it before a commander is out.
Cast no wheel in the first three turns.
Spend Swords to Plowshares or Get Lost in the first three turns only on a creature that kills a commander on sight, or on a combo piece.
First commander. Brallin on turn four with a red source; Shabraz first if Rhystic Study, Teferi's Ageless Insight or Bard is already out, or if red is missing.

Protection on that commander the turn it lands: Brotherhood Regalia ({1} on a legend, ward {2}, unblockable) or Robe of Stars ({1}), then Lightning Greaves ({0}) last. Keep Flawless Maneuver and Deflecting Swat in hand.

The conversion piece for that commander. Brallin: Torbran, Gratuitous Violence, Artist's Talent, Glint-Horn Buccaneer or Magmakin Artillerist. Shabraz: Teferi's Ageless Insight, Bard, King of Dale or Knowledge Is Power. Either: Lae'zel.
Loot every turn. Each card discarded is a counter on Brallin and a ping at every opponent; each card drawn is a counter on Shabraz and 1 life.

The kit: one double-strike source (Shu Yun, Embercleave, Blade Historian, Boros Charm, Akroma's Will) and one evasion source (Brotherhood Regalia, Shabraz's flying, Shabraz's {W/U} for Brallin, Brallin's {R} trample for Shabraz).
Second commander when the first is protected and the mana is spare.
The wheel last, on the turn you swing (log:002). Stack 001: Windfall for seven with both out takes each opponent from 40 to 33 and leaves both commanders 10/10.
Untap. Count each opponent's open mana and colours before you cast anything.
Loot in your main phase: Kitsa, Mary Read and Anne Bonny, Faithless Looting. Teferi, Master of Time's +1 waits for another seat's turn.
Equip at sorcery speed, Lightning Greaves last.
Attack with the commander that has evasion. With Inti out, discard a card as you attack: a counter and trample on an attacker, a Brallin trigger, and an exiled card you can play.
Pass with Flawless Maneuver or Deflecting Swat in hand (both free with a commander out), and {W} for Swords to Plowshares or Loran's Escape, or {U} for Stubborn Denial.
Count commander damage per commander per seat: 21 from Shabraz, or 21 from Brallin, on one player. The two do not add together.

Count the size after the wheel. Each card drawn is +1 on Shabraz; each card discarded is +1 on Brallin; Lae'zel makes each placement one more. A 10/10 with double strike deals 20. Embercleave's +1/+1, Knowledge Is Power, Inti's counter or Jeskai Ascendancy's +1/+1 makes the 21st.
Cast Grand Abolisher the turn before. On the kill turn no opponent casts a spell or activates an artifact, creature or enchantment ability.

Sequence the turn: wheel first and collect the triggers, then double strike, then attack. The wheel is a noncreature spell, so it triggers Shu Yun: pay {R/W}{R/W} and target the commander. Embercleave has flash and costs {1} less per attacker: cast it after attackers are declared.
With Consecrated Sphinx on the battlefield, both commanders out and 49 or more cards in your library, cast Wheel of Fortune. Stack 009: the cleanup discard fires Brallin past 40 at every seat.
Wait a turn if a blue seat has mana open and you hold neither Grand Abolisher on the battlefield nor a counter, or if the count is short and nothing in hand adds the last point.

optics: Until a commander has counters, the table sees a loot deck with two 3/3s and ranks you low.
The first wheel changes that. The table split on it in game 001: 'people either loved it or hated it' (log:001).
A commander with Lightning Greaves reads as a creature; a commander with Embercleave or beside Shu Yun reads as the kill. Attach the double strike on the swing turn.
Consecrated Sphinx beside Brallin is the stack 009 board. Expect it to draw the next removal spell.
The pilot called game 002 a bracket 3 list at a bracket 4 table (log:002). At that table you are the slow deck, not the threat.
reveal: Hold Embercleave in hand. It has flash and attaches when it enters; cast it after attackers are declared.
Hold Akroma's Will and Boros Charm for the attack. Blade Historian goes down the turn before the swing, not earlier.
Put Torbran, Gratuitous Violence and Fiery Emancipation down on the turn the wheel or Brallin's attack follows, or when Idyllic Tutor has a second target to find.
Cast Consecrated Sphinx when Wheel of Fortune follows on your next turn, or behind Grand Abolisher.
Pass with zero mana open when Flawless Maneuver or Deflecting Swat is the shield. Both are free while you control a commander.
alliances: Offer removal, not wheels. Swords to Plowshares or Get Lost on another seat's problem buys a rotation.
Brallin's pings hit every opponent on every discard. Do not promise a seat a pass you break with your next loot.
When a seat asks you to stop wheeling, agree and loot instead, and keep the one wheel you need for the kill (log:002).
Break a deal only on the turn the commander damage or the wheel kills.
targets: Commander damage goes at one seat until it dies. A seat at 14 from Shabraz takes the next 7 from Shabraz, not from Brallin.
First, the seat with no flyer or reach to block Shabraz, or no untapped blocker for an unblockable or trampling Brallin.
Next, the combo seat. Game 002 ended on one (log:002).
The go-wide seat before the control seat when its board races you (log:001).
Never the seat holding open blue mana when you have neither Grand Abolisher out nor a counter in hand.
